user_query: Investigate protein name, curated function, localization, biological processes/pathways and evidence for DOT1L/DOT1 H3K79 methyltransferase; Pfam DOT1 PF08123 relevance.

function: Histone methyltransferase that methylates 'Lys-79' of histone H3. Histones in nucleosomes are preferred as substrate compared to free histones. Binds to DNA (By similarity). Together with MLLT3/AF9, is involved in SCNN1A transcriptional repression following H3K79 hypermethylation at the promoter (PubMed:16236820).
